The fourth quarter numbers land at the same time as a new shelf registration. This gives CleanSpark the option to issue a wide range of securities in the future if management decides extra funding is useful.

The filing covers common and preferred equity, debt securities, warrants and bundled units. This sets up a financing toolkit that can support bitcoin mining operations or potential growth in data center infrastructure as opportunities arise.

Run a discounted cash flow backwards. It is the only honest way to find out what a price is asking you to believe, because it removes your opinion from the exercise and leaves only the market's. For a company that grew 11% in the quarter it just reported, whose advertising business grew 22%, and whose chat application sits in the pocket of 1.44 billion people.
